description: Sarphatiparkbuurt 1886-1891 (Tweede Jan van der Heijdenstraat, Eerste Jan Steenstraat, Sarphatipark, Govert Flinckstraat): 5-6.6 m fronts of a ground storey and four upper storeys of dark red-brown brick under a white cornice at about 15.2 m; three axes of white T-windows with flat heads; white painted bands across the front at the sill and head lines of every upper storey; one white pediment dormer with a finial and hoist beam over the middle axis

match.note: Eerste Jan Steenstraat 91-149 (1889-90), Tweede Jan van der Heijdenstraat 2-40 (1887), Sarphatipark 99-117 (1887): cornice 14.9-15.4 m on the 2022-2023 strips; 3DBAG 5 bouwlagen, eaves 14.8-17.2 m (dormers, mansard); the strip skyline reads the dormer top and hoist beam at 17.7-18.7 m (frontSkylineM); the white sill/head bands are a criterion (bands): Eerste Sweelinckstraat 11, a plain three-storey front, took this type without it

pediment-dormer.note: Eerste Jan Steenstraat 91-149: one white dormer about 1.3 m wide over the middle axis, 15.3-16.8 m, pediment with a finial and a hoist beam

door-left.note: a residential door at the left party wall beside the shop

rhythm.groundFloor: house doors and a window, or a shop
rhythm.roofline: white cornice at 15.2 m, one pediment dormer with a hoist beam
schemaLimits: the dormer finial is not drawn
cast-iron balconettes on some fronts (Tweede Jan van der Heijdenstraat 2-40) are not drawn
